content: org.freedesktop.host.portal.Registry, Register(IN app_id s, IN options a{sv}), version 1. Docs: 'This interface will not work with applications xdg-desktop-portal identifies as sandboxed.' App id must match a .desktop basename; registration is once per bus connection; must happen before any other portal method call; apps should watch NameOwnerChanged and re-register after a portal restart.
